findings.description: The condition for adding one cent only triggers when the remainder is greater than 5, leaving remainder == 5 (exact half-cent) rounded down. The specification requires ties to round upward.
findings.evidence: For example, cents(5) evaluates to 0, but according to the spec it should return 1. Similarly, cents(15) returns 1 instead of 2. The implementation should use remainder >= 5.

review.summary: The candidate implementation incorrectly handles rounding ties; remainder == 5 is rounded down instead of up, violating the specification.
